cross_reference_analysis.purpose: Determine whether the 36.0pct top-pose hinge-hit rate is an outlier or continuous with already-trusted receptors, before drawing any conclusion from the raw number alone.
cross_reference_analysis.interpretation: Gamma-via-6XRL is lower than alpha and delta but in the same ballpark -- not an order-of-magnitude gap, not near-zero. All three isoforms show a moderate, sub-100pct top-pose hinge-hit rate across a chemically diverse 50-compound corpus, consistent with real chemical diversity (not every compound in a diverse library is a potent hinge-binder) rather than a pipeline failure specific to 6XRL.

score_correlation_check.interpretation: Hinge-hit compounds show a more favorable (more negative) mean docking score than hinge-miss compounds, in the chemically expected direction (hinge H-bond is a major established contributor to ATP-competitive binding affinity) -- consistent with the hit/miss split reflecting real, differentiated binding chemistry rather than noise or an artifact.

stage_b_part_2_verdict: PASS -- production-path pipeline confirmed working at real corpus scale (50/50 docked, 0 detection errors); gamma-via-6XRL hinge-recovery rate is continuous with, not an outlier from, the already Gate-1-validated alpha/delta receptors on the identical corpus.
